projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
A unified analytics dashboard that (1) ingests and processes customer data from CSV files, (2) analyzes application log data, and (3) renders interactive visualizations. Work is organized into five milestones: Foundation & Architecture, Customer CSV Processing, Application Log Analysis, Visualization Components, and Integration/Testing/Deployment. Every task is scoped to a complexity of 6 or lower so nothing is too large to execute in a single work session.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, visualization, csv, log-analysis

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Foundation & Architecture
tasks.details: Establish the technical foundation for the analytics dashboard: agreed requirements, system architecture, data flow design, repository/CI setup, and provisioned storage. Nothing downstream can be built reliably until the data contracts and architecture are settled. Exit criteria: architecture doc approved, repo with CI green, storage provisioned, and requirements signed off.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: Build the end-to-end pipeline that turns raw customer CSV files into clean, deduplicated, query-ready customer records. Covers schema validation, cleaning/normalization, identity resolution, incremental loading, and pipeline tests. Exit criteria: a sample CSV set loads reliably, invalid rows are quarantined with reasons, and the resulting table is query-ready.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Build the pipeline that ingests application logs, parses them into a structured schema, and produces the metrics the dashboard needs (error rates, latency, traffic patterns, anomalies). Exit criteria: sample logs parse at target rate, key metrics are produced on a schedule, and anomaly rules are validated against known incidents.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Visualization Components
tasks.details: Deliver the front-end dashboard: reusable chart components, layout, filtering, and the wiring of those components to the data APIs. Exit criteria: all agreed charts render real data, filters work across the dashboard, and the UI passes accessibility and responsiveness checks.

tasks.name: Milestone 5: Integration, Testing & Deployment
tasks.details: Bring the three workstreams together: API integration, end-to-end testing, performance tuning, deployment, monitoring, and documentation/handoff. Exit criteria: dashboard deployed to production, monitored, E2E suite green in CI, and runbook + user docs delivered.

tasks.name: Define dashboard requirements and user stories
tasks.details: Interview stakeholders and write the agreed scope: the questions the dashboard must answer, the personas who use it, the chart inventory, and refresh expectations. Produce a prioritized backlog of user stories with acceptance criteria. Output: requirements doc + user story list reviewed and signed off.

tasks.name: Design system architecture and data flow
tasks.details: Produce the architecture document: component diagram (CSV ingestion, log ingestion, storage layer, metrics/API layer, frontend), data flow from source to chart, technology choices with rationale, and the interface contracts (data schemas and API shapes) that milestones 2-4 will build against. Include failure handling and refresh cadence.

tasks.name: Set up repository, CI/CD, and environments
tasks.details: Create the monorepo/repos with agreed directory structure, linting and formatting, pre-commit hooks, and a CI pipeline that runs build + tests on every PR. Define dev/staging/prod configuration and secrets handling. Output: first green CI run on a skeleton commit.

tasks.name: Provision data storage and warehouse schemas
tasks.details: Provision the database/warehouse and create the initial schemas for raw and modeled customer data, structured logs, and pre-aggregated metrics. Set up access roles, retention policy, and a local development instance. Output: schemas applied in dev and staging, connection config documented.

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion with schema validation
tasks.details: Implement the file reader that accepts customer CSV uploads, detects encoding/delimiter, maps columns to the agreed customer schema, and validates every row (types, required fields, formats, ranges). Invalid rows go to a quarantine table with a reason code; valid rows land in a raw staging table. Output: ingestion job runs on a sample file set with a row-count and rejection summary.

tasks.name: Implement data cleaning and normalization
tasks.details: Normalize staged customer records: trim/case-fold names, parse and standardize emails and phone numbers, canonicalize country/region and date formats, and handle nulls and sentinel values per the data dictionary. Output: normalized table plus a documented before/after field mapping.

tasks.name: Define customer match rules and confidence thresholds
tasks.details: Specify the matching strategy: deterministic keys (exact email, normalized phone) and fuzzy keys (name + address similarity), the blocking strategy to keep comparisons tractable, the similarity scoring method, and the confidence thresholds that separate auto-merge from manual review. Output: written rule set plus a scored test set of known duplicate and non-duplicate pairs.

tasks.name: Add watermarking and idempotent incremental loads
tasks.details: Track a per-file and per-row watermark and upsert by natural key so reruns never duplicate rows, including support for resuming a partially processed file. Output: two consecutive runs prove no duplicate inserts and correct row deltas.

tasks.name: Write CSV pipeline tests and data quality checks
tasks.details: Unit-test validation, normalization, and match rules with fixture CSVs covering malformed rows, unicode, duplicates, and nulls. Add automated data quality assertions (row counts, uniqueness of customer_id, no null required fields) that run in CI. Output: suite green in CI with coverage on core transforms.

tasks.name: Define log schema and parsing rules
tasks.details: Inventory the application log formats (app, access, error) and write the target structured schema: timestamp, level, service, request_id, user/customer_id, endpoint, status_code, latency_ms, message, error_code. Document regex/pattern rules per format and how unparseable lines are handled. Output: log schema spec + parsing rule table.

tasks.name: Build log ingestion and parsing service
tasks.details: Implement the service that tails or batch-reads log files, applies the parsing rules, and writes structured events to the log table. Handle multi-line stack traces, timezone normalization, and a dead-letter path for unparseable lines. Output: sample log bundle parsed with a reported success rate and DLQ contents.

tasks.name: Build error-rate and traffic metric aggregations
tasks.details: Materialize per-service and per-endpoint error counts and error rate, request volume over time, and top error codes into the metrics table at 1-minute and 1-hour granularity. Add the scheduled refresh for these aggregates. Output: populated metrics verified against manual log counts.

tasks.name: Implement error-rate and latency anomaly rules
tasks.details: Two explainable rules: error rate exceeding a rolling baseline by N sigma, and p95 latency regressing past a set threshold. Each emits an anomaly record with severity, the baseline it was compared against, and a link to the contributing log slice. Output: rules replayed against historical data with the false-positive rate measured.

tasks.name: Validate log pipeline against sample logs and known incidents
tasks.details: Build a fixture set of logs including one known production incident, and write automated tests asserting parse success rate, correct metric values, and that the incident triggers the expected anomaly. Add the suite to CI. Output: green test suite and a short validation report.

tasks.name: Finalize chart inventory and UI specification
tasks.details: Turn the agreed user stories into a concrete chart list: for each chart, define the question it answers, chart type, required metrics/fields, filters, and empty/error states. Produce low-fidelity wireframes of the dashboard layout. Output: chart inventory table + wireframes approved.

tasks.name: Scaffold frontend app and component library
tasks.details: Set up the frontend framework and a component library theme: layout shell, typography, color tokens, spacing, and charting library choice. Include a component playground/storybook page for visual review. Output: skeleton app builds and deploys to staging with the theme applied.

tasks.name: Build reusable chart components
tasks.details: Implement the chart primitives from the inventory (time series line, KPI tile, bar, stacked bar, table with sorting) as reusable, data-agnostic components with consistent tooltips, legends, and loading/empty states. Output: each component demoed in the playground with mock data.

tasks.name: Build dashboard page layout and KPI sections
tasks.details: Implement the app shell, responsive grid, KPI header, and page sections from the approved wireframes, using placeholder data only. Output: navigable layout that matches the wireframes at desktop width.

tasks.name: Connect visualization components to data APIs
tasks.details: Replace mock data with live API calls: add a typed data-access layer, request caching/deduplication, and per-chart loading and error states. Map API responses into the chart component contracts. Output: every chart on the dashboard renders real data from staging.

tasks.name: Implement responsiveness and accessibility for the dashboard
tasks.details: Make the layout work from mobile to wide desktop, add keyboard navigation, focus states, ARIA labels and chart text alternatives, and verify color contrast on the palette. Output: accessibility audit results and a responsive review at three breakpoints.

tasks.name: Build query and metrics API layer
tasks.details: Expose the customer and log metrics through a small, versioned read API: endpoints for KPIs, time series, breakdowns, and detail tables, with filter parameters matching the dashboard's filter bar. Add validation, pagination, and error responses per the architecture contract. Output: documented API with example responses for every chart.

tasks.name: Write end-to-end test suite for the dashboard
tasks.details: Automate the critical user journeys in a browser test suite: load dashboard, change date range and filters, verify KPI and chart values against seeded data, drill down, and confirm empty/error states. Run in CI against a seeded test environment. Output: E2E suite green in CI with documented journeys.

tasks.name: Performance tune queries and dashboard load time
tasks.details: Profile the slowest API endpoints and charts against a realistic data volume, add indexes and pre-aggregation where needed, and set page-load budgets (e.g. initial render under 2s). Confirm with before/after benchmark numbers. Output: performance report and a regression guard in CI.

tasks.name: Deploy to production with monitoring and alerts
tasks.details: Promote the stack through staging to production via the CI/CD pipeline, configure dashboards and alerts for pipeline failures, fresh-data lag, and API error rate, and verify a rollback procedure works. Output: production URL live, alerts firing on a synthetic failure, rollback rehearsed.

tasks.name: Write documentation, runbook, and handoff
tasks.details: Write the README/architecture summary, data dictionary, how to run each pipeline, dashboard user guide, and an on-call runbook covering common failures and recovery steps. Run a handoff session with the owning team. Output: docs published and handoff completed.

tasks.name: Implement duplicate merging with survivorship and lineage
tasks.details: Apply the agreed match rules to merge duplicates into a stable customer_id, resolve conflicting field values with explicit survivorship rules (e.g. most recent non-null wins), and write a lineage table mapping every source row to its surviving record. Backfill the existing customer table. Output: merge job plus a reconciliation report covering merges, conflicts, and unresolved pairs.
